title.narrative: Pre-positioning Core Relief Items to meet immediate needs and support UK logistics personnel.

description.narrative: Core Relief Items (CRIs) will be pre-positioned and delivered as part of the humanitarian response in Gaza. The initial focus will be on coverage kits, wound care packages, and blankets to meet immediate priority needs.
